research.skipped_reason: Topic does not require outside facts. Use first-party facts, opinion, and hypotheticals only.

claims.claim: Brandible's custom websites typically launch in 2–4 weeks from kickoff to go-live.
Brandible web design projects typically run $2,000 to $10,000+, depending on scope.
Landing pages can move faster than the 2–4 week range; stores, booking systems, or complex sites take longer.
Delays in most website projects come from copy, photos, and feedback not being ready on the client side, not from the build itself.
Starting a project without copy, photos, or a clear message ready almost always extends the timeline beyond what the owner expected.
A site with real photos of your work, team, or space performs better than one filled with stock imagery.
Spending time on your message before a project starts reduces revision time once the site is being built.
A hypothetical landing page for one service with a contact page, booking form, and clear call to action can sometimes move faster than the 2–4 week range.
A hypothetical full site with multiple service categories, a quote form, photo galleries, and scheduling integrations is a different scope than a landing page, though still not a six-month project.
